card.name: Words before an expected noun
card.fires_on: Adjectives, determiners and word starts that come just before a noun the text is about to name, such as usual, important, elegant, all or other. Also the first letters of long capitalised or medical words.

modes.label: Modifiers before a noun
modes.description: An adjective or determiner in older narrative or historical prose that sets up a following noun.

modes.label: Start of a long medical term
modes.description: The first letters of a long medical word, often in capitals or split mid-word.

card.writes: It lowers words like union and relationship, with a weak push toward words like insight and variation, so no clear single effect.
card.plain: It fires on a word that is only the lead-in to a noun, such as an adjective, or on the opening letters of a long medical word.
